_title: Silent Cinema – Movie Charades Party Game
_description: Act out films without a word and let your team guess! 600 films, 11 genres, 75 languages. A free charades party game for friends and family.
_keywords: movie charades, charades game, silent cinema, guess the movie, party game, charades app
hero_title: Silent Cinema<small>Act out the film, let your team guess it!</small>
hero_lead: The classic movie charades game, now on your phone. The actor sees a film title and acts it out without a single word — the team has to guess it before time runs out. Films appear under the titles they were released with in your country.
how_desc: A round ends when every player has acted once; after the number of rounds you chose, the team with the most points wins.
how_1_d: Type the players and split them into two teams. Choose the timer, passes, rounds and film genres.
how_2_d: The screen tells you who gets the phone and who guesses. 3-2-1… Action!
how_3_d: Swipe the card toward the green button for correct, toward the red one for wrong, down to pass — or tap the big buttons.
how_4_d: Correct is +1, breaking a rule is −1. At the end you see the scores, the streaks and the star of the night.
feat_desc: Made for game nights, birthdays, family gatherings and road trips.
f_1_d: Action, superheroes, adventure, comedy, drama, horror, sci-fi, romance, animation, thrillers and classics.
f_2_d: Every film appears under its release title in your country — even Spain and Latin America, Portugal and Brazil are separate.
f_3_d: Learn the charades gestures for film, number of words, which word, syllables and "sounds like" inside the game.
f_4_d: Add the films your group loves and play them alongside the catalog.
f_6_d: Interface and film titles in 75 languages; switch the language any time.
screens_desc: The home screen, a film card and the genre picker.
cta_desc: Silent Cinema is free. Download it and start the party.
